summary: ACCEPT after ELEVEN rounds. The v2 boot hold no longer releases entries before state restoration completes, and the telemetry describing that state no longer lies. Verified by execution and mutation throughout. THE ARC: the same 'absence reads as safety' vacuity relocated NINE times - not dangerous on [], all([]), 0 != 0, a sticky once-ever flag, the pager, sh()'s return value, safety_flag_on()'s absent-variable fallback, hardcoded telemetry constants, and finally an evaluated= field scoped to the whole watchlist while its sibling counts described only the delta. Each round the named instance was fixed and the class moved one token over; what finally closed it was scoping every reported number to the population actually measured. THIS HEAD: the fix is ONE line at bot.py:1772 - len(results) if new_symbols else len(selected) - plus two named tests, 42 insertions and 1 deletion, no scope creep. Both mutants DIE against a 145-test baseline: reverting to len(selected) emits the exact defect 'evaluated=25 confirmed=3 could_not_tell=0' and is killed by test_unreadable_exclusion_delta_counts_only_the_symbols_actually_seeded; swapping len(ineligible_exclude) for len(self._schwab_ineligible_cache) emits applied=2 where the fan-out intersection was 1 and is killed by test_unreadable_exclusion_telemetry_counts_the_fanout_intersection. ⭐ That second mutant survived every previous round and is now the last one dead. CARRIED FORWARD from round 11, all confirmed load-bearing: all five hold-warning sites rate-limited at 1 per 25 drives with a PER-REASON key so a changed reason stays immediately visible; the three CPHI-class rationale sentences restored verbatim above an intact NOT LOAD-BEARING block; and mutant m - a two-way latch in the hold branch that released entries on alternate publish cycles - killed by exactly one test, the new repeated-cycle one, which the reviewer confirmed non-vacuous. Earlier rounds established a 37-to-40 case pager matrix with zero mismatches and a real controlled pair, sh() returning UNKNOWN on raise OR non-zero exit OR empty output, safety_flag_on treating an absent variable as UNKNOWN rather than OFF, both ineligibility loaders failing closed, and the fan-out policy restored verbatim so no leg divergence is manufactured. HONESTY OF THE KILL, recorded because it matters: M1's test pins literals over a genuine partial delta rather than asserting evaluated == confirmed + could_not_tell arithmetically. The pinned triple is the reconciling one and the defect string is named explicitly in a negative assertion, so the specific regression is caught by construction - but a coincidentally-equal value would slip. NOT MEASURED, stated plainly: only the four focused files were run for these two mutants, so there is no full-suite check that the line-1657 change breaks nothing elsewhere; could_not_tell is never exercised non-zero in M1's killing test because its seed stub always returns True; and no mutant probed the still-correct empty-delta branch. ⛔ DEPLOY GATE, unchanged and independent of this pin: rest_warmed == evaluated requires EVERY selected symbol to produce a bar within 300s, and Friday's [V2-REST-WARMED] lines were 14 to 18 minutes apart. Restart v2 only after 16:00 ET with bars still flowing, measure the elapsed time to [V2-BOOT-HOLD] released, and ROLL BACK if it has not released by 20:00 ET - do not carry an unreleased hold into the next open.
